2026_03_ATL_GB.headline: Penix returns at Lambeau as Atlanta tests Green Bay’s short-week depth
2026_03_ATL_GB.paragraph1: Atlanta turns to Michael Penix Jr. after Cooper Rush struggled through two losses, giving Kevin Stefanski a chance to rebuild the passing game around Penix and Bijan Robinson. Green Bay returns home after an overtime win, but Jordan Love is working through an offense missing Josh Jacobs and dealing with injuries up front and at receiver. The matchup hinges on whether Atlanta can protect Penix and whether the Packers can generate enough offense without leaning on a depleted supporting cast.
2026_03_ATL_GB.model_rationale: Green Bay’s home structure and defensive pressure create the steadier path, while Atlanta’s upside depends on Penix immediately restoring efficiency to a stalled offense.
